caption: The drawing features three small, distinct objects positioned near the center of an otherwise plain, light beige background. The central object is an oval ring that is colored gold with some grey and black detailing suggesting facets or decoration. To the left of the ring, there is a simple outline sketch of what appears to be an irregular, cloud-like shape, rendered in thin black lines with no interior shading or color. To the right of the ring, there is a drawing of a small, straight cylindrical object resembling a nail or screw, also outlined in black with minimal detailing. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the artist’s name “M. Fenga…” is faintly inscribed.
title: Mourning Ring
